I choose to remember that care is not a static state but a dynamic dance of presence—sometimes gentle and nurturing, sometimes fierce and protective, always rooted in the recognition of another's agency and inherent worth. Our friendship has been a practice in seeing each other as whole beings capable of both receiving support and offering strength in equal measure.
